review_scope: Restarted one-testcase-at-a-time review from the first source testcase
review_method: One source testcase row per review; no batch, category, keyword, regex, or copy-forward template classification.

cases.purpose: Verify by physical inspection that all DUT components are seated correctly and that the inspected assembly matches the approved hardware recipe.
preconditions: A qualified operator has physical access to the DUT and the approved hardware/recipe documentation.
Use appropriate power isolation and ESD controls before opening or touching the chassis.
The component checklist and required photo locations are defined.
safety_checks: Do not perform the inspection on an energized chassis if the platform procedure requires power isolation.
Do not force, reseat, remove, or replace a component merely to make the criterion pass.
Do not clear dmesg, syslog, SEL, or blackbox evidence; preserve existing evidence before inspection.
cases.test_command: Manual physical and visual inspection of every specified component for correct seating; capture operator photos and the blackbox status record.
risk_notes: Incorrect handling can damage connectors, cards, cables, or other components.
The remote agent cannot physically inspect the DUT or produce trustworthy seating photographs.
expected_evidence: Operator checklist identifying every inspected component.
Timestamped photos showing component seating and any discrepancy.
Blackbox status record and preserved before/after system or BMC evidence when available.
logs_to_collect: Existing kernel, system, and BMC/SEL evidence without clearing prior logs
blocked_conditions: No qualified operator or physical access is available.
The approved component list, seating criteria, or photo/evidence requirement is missing.
The inspection would require unsafe energized handling.

deepseek_original_review.ai_commands: Not runnable by agent: physical/visual inspection of component seating accuracy requires a person physically present at the machine.
deepseek_original_review.ai_logs_output: Operator takes photos and records blackbox status; agent cannot produce this evidence over SSH.
deepseek_original_review.risk: Component seat accuracy is a physical/visual check; human only.

cases.gpt_second_review_findings: DeepSeek's NO classification is correct because the acceptance criterion is physical seating accuracy. GPT additionally rejects the source instruction to clear logs as a baseline action; existing kernel, system, BMC/SEL, and blackbox evidence must be preserved. The agent may organize operator evidence but must not claim that it performed the inspection.
cases.blast_radius: Physical DUT hardware, connectors, cards, and cables; no remote command should alter the DUT.
cases.recovery_procedure: Stop the inspection if damage, abnormal seating, or unsafe handling is observed. Preserve photos and logs, do not force the component, and escalate to the hardware owner.
manual_steps: Operator performs the physical inspection and records each component.
Operator captures the required photos and blackbox status evidence.
cases.openhands_instruction: Do not attempt to simulate or claim the physical inspection. Request the operator's checklist, photos, and blackbox evidence; report only the supplied evidence. PASS/FAIL/BLOCKED is decided by the end user.

cases.purpose: Inspect the DUT chassis and node surfaces to verify that no accessible edge can injure a user during normal operation or handling.
preconditions: A qualified operator has physical access to every exterior chassis and node surface.
Use the approved mechanical-safety checklist and appropriate ESD/power-isolation controls.
safety_checks: Do not run a hand over an energized, hot, sharp, or otherwise unsafe area.
Do not clear existing dmesg, syslog, SEL, or blackbox evidence; this testcase is physical and does not need log deletion.
cases.test_command: Qualified operator performs hand and visual inspection of every accessible chassis/node edge and records any sharp edge with photos.
risk_notes: The inspection itself can cause injury if performed without appropriate protection.
A remote agent cannot feel, see, or photograph the physical edges and must not claim completion.
expected_evidence: Operator checklist covering every accessible edge/sheet.
Timestamped photos of inspected areas and any defect.
Operator statement of whether a sharp edge affecting user operation was found.
logs_to_collect: Existing system/BMC evidence only if another concurrent issue is observed
blocked_conditions: No qualified operator or physical access is available.
The inspection area cannot be safely accessed or the acceptance scope is not defined.

deepseek_original_review.ai_commands: Not runnable by agent: the mechanical check requires hand and visual inspection of every exterior edge/sheet.
deepseek_original_review.ai_logs_output: Operator performs the physical inspection and reports the visual/mechanical result; agent cannot operate or see the hardware.

cases.gpt_second_review_findings: DeepSeek's NO classification is correct. The source purpose is a tactile and visual injury-prevention inspection, not an OS or BMC state check. GPT additionally removes the unnecessary log-clearing step and requires complete operator coverage of the accessible chassis/node surfaces.
cases.blast_radius: Physical operator safety and DUT chassis surfaces; no remote command should modify the DUT.
cases.recovery_procedure: Stop immediately if an injury hazard or damaged edge is found, photograph and isolate the area, and escalate to the hardware owner. Do not file, bend, or modify the chassis as part of this test.
manual_steps: Inspect every accessible chassis/node edge by sight and safe touch.
Record and photograph any sharp edge or inaccessible area.
cases.openhands_instruction: Do not attempt this inspection remotely. Request the operator checklist and photos, then report only the supplied evidence. PASS/FAIL/BLOCKED is decided by the end user.

cases.purpose: Verify that the specified nodes/components can be physically installed and removed easily, and that the OSFP module remains detectable after the approved plug cycle and reboot.
preconditions: Qualified operator has the correct OSFP module, chassis access, approved installation procedure, and recovery plan.
Confirm whether the reboot after the physical cycle is permitted and capture the pre-cycle device identity.
pre_check_commands: Record the current device enumeration and kernel/BMC state before the physical cycle; do not clear existing logs.
safety_checks: Use power isolation and ESD controls required by the platform procedure.
Do not force the OSFP module or perform an unapproved reboot.
cases.test_command: Operator physically installs and removes the OSFP module, then performs the approved post-cycle reboot and agent-assisted device-detection check.
risk_notes: Incorrect insertion/removal can damage the module, connector, or chassis.
The physical action cannot be performed or verified remotely; reboot is service-impacting and requires approval.
expected_evidence: Kernel/BMC evidence after the approved reboot, without clearing prior logs.
post_check_commands: Collect device enumeration, kernel error evidence, and BMC/SEL evidence after the operator action and approved reboot.
logs_to_collect: Device enumeration before and after the cycle
blocked_conditions: No qualified operator or physical access.
Reboot permission, OSFP identity, or expected detection criteria are missing.
The module or recovery path is unknown.

deepseek_original_review.ai_commands: Not runnable by agent: physical OSFP seating/unseating and reboot/detection confirmation require a person at the machine.
deepseek_original_review.ai_logs_output: Operator performs the physical cycle and reports the result; agent cannot manipulate or visually verify the hardware.

cases.gpt_second_review_findings: DeepSeek's NO classification is correct for the physical install/uninstall action. GPT separates the remotely verifiable post-action enumeration from the physical step and adds explicit reboot approval, pre-cycle identity capture, and recovery requirements. The agent must not claim the physical step occurred.
cases.blast_radius: OSFP module/connector and DUT availability during the physical cycle and approved reboot.
cases.recovery_procedure: Stop if insertion/removal is abnormal or post-cycle enumeration fails; preserve photos and logs, do not repeatedly reseat or reboot, and escalate to the hardware owner.
manual_steps: Operator installs and removes the OSFP module according to the platform procedure.
Operator supplies photos and confirms the physical action; agent performs only the permitted post-action evidence collection.
cases.openhands_instruction: Do not perform or claim the physical OSFP cycle. After operator confirmation and explicit reboot approval, collect only the approved post-action detection/log evidence. End user decides PASS/FAIL/BLOCKED.

blocked_conditions: No qualified operator or physical access.
